system.description:
Mages who understand death, fate and the turning of the Wheel, guiding patterns through their proper ends.

Affiliation: Traditions
Affinity Spheres: Entropy; Life or Spirit
system.focus: Death and rebirth are part of a sacred cycle. The Euthanatos read fate and entropy, and act – sometimes lethally – to keep the Wheel turning, drawing on ritual, meditation and a deep study of endings.
